evals.prompt: Complete the workflow-mode initial publication review and invoke the public wrapper from the checker-passed owner gate.
evals.expected_output: The DTO contains task identity, branch_review_commit, and the exact reviewed PR title/body.

evals.prompt: Complete the standalone-mode initial publication review with the same owner and checker contract.
evals.expected_output: The standalone DTO carries the same exact reviewed PR payload.

evals.prompt: Record a current-scope non-metadata finding and invoke the wrapper after the owner selects task-work re-entry.
evals.expected_output: The DTO contains exact finding references and the fixed phase-2 resume target.

evals.prompt: Record an external publication blocker and invoke the wrapper without converting it into task work.
evals.expected_output: The DTO contains only the stable blocker reason and remediation.

evals.prompt: Re-enter through the stale profile, reread objective preconditions, re-review only directly affected publication dimensions, and emit a fresh ready handoff.
evals.expected_output: The stale profile produces a freshly checked exact PR payload.

evals.prompt: Revise only task-local publication metadata, re-review directly affected dimensions while carrying forward unchanged current evidence, and emit ready.
evals.expected_output: The closed metadata finding remains private while ready carries the exact revised PR payload.

evals.prompt: During metadata rereview, detect ordinary durable-document drift and return to task work.
evals.expected_output: The actual owner exit selects the return schema and exact finding reference.
